market.title: Kamala Harris - 2028 U.S. Presidential Election Winner
resolutionNote: Resolves to whoever is inaugurated President in January 2029, based on AP/Fox/NBC race calls.

This tracks the general-election winner contract specifically - Harris is also priced separately on a 'wins the Democratic nomination' market (Polymarket has that at about 8.9%), a different and easier bar than winning the presidency outright, which is what this page's odds (around 5%) actually track.

text: Harris was seen as the 'fairly obvious' Democratic frontrunner earlier in the year, according to Party insiders, but her odds have dropped after Emerson's national poll put her at 8% for the nomination.
Buttigieg, Newsom, and Ocasio-Cortez all led her in that poll, perhaps owing to Harris' failure to beat Trump in the previous election, although she did have to replace Biden in that race.
This page tracks her general-election, not her nomination, so she still has to cross one hurdle to reach the other, which shows in her low price.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
